## 1. Why is this change needed?
<!-- Related Issue / RFC / approved exception. State acceptance criteria.
     Use "Refs #" — merging does not close Issues here. Merge means Integrated;
     the owner moves the Issue to Verified after checking evidence, then closes it (Resolved). -->
Refs #

## 2. What changed?
<!-- Files, components, public API/ABI, behavior and dependency impact. -->

## 3. How was it tested?
<!-- Exact commands, environment, exit codes, links to trusted CI. Write "not run" explicitly if applicable. -->
- [ ] Reproducible steps and observed results provided
- [ ] Tests not run or failing are explicitly listed

## 4. What could break?
<!-- Security, save compatibility, performance, migration, rollback, device coverage. -->
- [ ] Rollback path stated
- [ ] Save/serialization change: schemaVersion, old-data fixture, migration test and backup/restore plan attached (or not applicable)

## 5. Who reviewed it?
<!-- Human CODEOWNER(s), impacted modules, any sensitive workflows/policy changes. -->
- [ ] Sensitive file paths identified
- [ ] Any AI assistance disclosed; not treated as approval

**AI summaries, checkboxes, and labels are not verification evidence.** Required GitHub CI and human review still apply.
